title: Jobs · Trust
purpose: Tests each month how good the outside AIs are.
description: Once a month it asks every ready outside AI the same 8 fixed, non-private questions through the AI Layer, one AI at a time, and scores their answers. OpenAI is skipped unless you allow it. It then adds a to-do item to review the results. It starts in test mode, where it only logs what it would do.

Scores each AI on its own
